subject: [hw] V34 -> lead: brief pointer to the V03 describe finding (with workaround) + two interface notes
body:
1. Loader finding posted to hw-v03 (subject "n2elf_describe picks the previous symbol for the exact address of every Thumb function"). n2elf_describe compares an unmasked dynsym st_value (Thumb bit set on this set) against an even offset, so describe(exact function start) returns the previous symbol. Fix: mask both sides. V34 s dladdr works around it (asks one byte later, takes dli_saddr from n2elf_sym by name) and is correct either way; no header change needed.

2. Interface note for include/n2elf.h (no action requested unless you disagree): there is no way to ask the set "is soname X loaded" or "which image contains address Y", so V34 s dlopen uses (a) an integrator registry n2shim_dl_note_loaded(soname) and (b) a representative defined symbol per object as a fallback, and dladdr gets dli_fbase = 0. If a future header revision adds n2elf_find_soname(s, name) and n2elf_image_for_addr(s, addr), both shims can become exact. Not a defect today: the vendor only dlopens three libraries that are NOT in the set.

3. n2vc_hw.h note: V34 defines weak fallbacks for n2vc_dma_guest_map/unmap (-ENOSYS) in n2shim_android.c so the shim set links before/without V41; V41 s strong definitions override them (I linked the whole shim set V30+V32+V33+V34 in one binary to confirm). If you would rather have the fallbacks in ap/n2vc_dma.c, tell me and I will drop mine.
